author: (C. B. Adams, 1850)

note.en: A tiny snail a few millimetres long listed in the Costa Rican Caribbean catalogue. Size and depth are typical values for the group, not measured locally.
note.es: Un caracol diminuto de pocos milímetros listado en el catálogo del Caribe de Costa Rica. El tamaño y la profundidad son valores típicos del grupo, no medidos localmente.

evidence: Added: not in the original record list for this part

sources.t: Rodríguez Sevilla, Vargas & Cortés 2003, Gastrópodos de la costa Caribe de Costa Rica, Rev. Biol. Trop. 51 (Suppl. 3): 305-399
WoRMS: Stosicia aberrans (C. B. Adams, 1850), accepted name

recWhy: Only on the Costa Rican Caribbean snail catalogue (Rodríguez Sevilla et al. 2003); locality not given.
